title: rest(public forms): `GET /forms/:slug` localizes the object schema but returns the form's section labels untranslated, so an anonymous zh-CN visitor reads English section titles (the producer behind objectui#12333)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect on a published anonymous surface, measured. File-at-destination, for objectstack triage. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9771) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`, from the os-dev report on objectstack-ai/objectui#12333. ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` an anonymous visitor of a published form (`/_console/f/:slug`) in a non-English locale. HotCRM's `/_console/f/contact-us` in zh-CN reads "Tell us about yourself" and its two sibling sections in English, while the field labels on the same page are Chinese (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 13).

## Cause chain (re-read by the filing seat on objectstack `origin/main`)

- **The client route is closed on purpose.** Since objectstack#22432, the `/i18n` domain answers an anonymous caller 401 (`packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts`, the anonymous-baseline block at its head). Since objectui#12034, the console's `loadLanguage` answers `{}` when signed out. So the client-side `objects.{object}._sections.{name}.label` lookup that objectui#8813 restored cannot fire for an anonymous visitor.
- **The server localizes only half the payload.** In `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `registerFormEndpoints` → `GET /forms/:slug`:
  - It translates `objectSchema` through `translateMetadataDocument('object', …)` (~`:9850`–`:9864`). That is why the field labels come out Chinese.
  - It returns `safeForm` with each section spread as `{ ...sec, fields }` (~`:9885`–`:9906`). The section's `label` and `description` stay as authored. The handler's own comment there says the form payload is otherwise un-translated.
- **The keys exist and match.** Each HotCRM section carries a `name`, and the zh-CN pack translates exactly `crm_lead._sections.{name}.label`. The os-dev measured this on the installed `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.0` with a HotCRM-shaped bundle: the object route gives `名`, and the view section route gives "Tell us about yourself".

## Ask

- The public form read localizes each section's `label` (and `description`) through `_sections` under `Accept-Language`, the way it already localizes `objectSchema`. Preferably this lives in the spec's translator, so the rest handler makes one call, instead of being a handler-local walk.
- Pin: a rest test that `GET /forms/:slug` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN` returns the translated section label.

## Not this card

A view-level form field's `placeholder` / `helpText` override has no translation key on `18.0.0-next.0`. The field translation declares `placeholder` / `help` for the object field only, and `_views.{view}` declares `label` / `description` / `emptyState` / `bulkActions`. That is the spec-contract question of the objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2094 family, which objectui triage routed to objectstack `domain:spec`.

**Consumer:** objectstack-ai/objectui#12333 moves to `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by:` this card. Once a release carrying the fix is installable in objectui, the console needs no change. Only the header of objectui's #8813 pin (`FormPage.sectionLabelI18n.test.tsx`) needs amending, to say that it covers a visitor who holds a bundle.

**Dedupe**, run 2026-10-14 with MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included:
- `public form slug section label not translated Accept-Language _sections anonymous form translateView sections` → 3 hits.
- `GET /forms/:slug localize form body sections i18n anonymous visitor` → 6 hits.

None is this subject. The nearest is #5408 (closed), the signed-in create/edit tab strip.

Dedupe words: public form section label untranslated; forms slug Accept-Language sections; _sections anonymous form; translateView sections.
